rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon stage"

        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001"
        score = 9

    strings:
        $x64_beacon_config = { 69 6E 73 74 61 6C 6C 65 72 2E 65 78 65 00 2D 61 20 2D 6E 6F 63 6F 6E 73 6F 6C 65 } // "installer.exe", "-a", "-noconsole"
        $http_get_uri = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $c2_header = "Host:" fullword ascii

    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // PE header
        $x64_beacon_config near 500 and
        $http_get_uri and $c2_header
}
